meta.notes: Statuses: NORMAL, ANOMALY (sensor step-change vs the asset's own baseline), BLIND_CLOUD, BLIND_ERROR, LEARNING (baseline accumulating). FIRMS pass times are inferred from regional detection clusters, labeled where used. Canadian assets carry a maintenance-lifecycle block (restart): a thermal state machine over the keyed FIRMS archive (states OPERATING / DOWN / STARTUP_TRANSIENT / RETURNED_PARTIAL) joined against the published maintenance schedule's turnaround windows; actual start/end timestamps there are sensor-estimated. Event kinds: SENSOR_ANOMALY, UNPLANNED_DOWN, PLAN_DEVIATION, RESTART_SIGNATURE.
